name: East Hebei Autonomous Council
native: 冀東防共自治政府 (Jìdōng Fánggòng Zìzhì Zhèngfǔ)

predecessors.name: Republic of China
predecessors.text: the Tanggu Truce demilitarised zone, 'the 22 counties in Hebei province' between the Great Wall and Beijing-Tianjin

successors.name: Provisional Government of the Republic of China
successors.text: 'absorbed ... into the collaborationist Provisional Government of China in February 1938'

ledger.x: 1935: Yin Ju-keng proclaims the East Hebei council.
25 November 1935: the council is Japan's client from its declaration of independence.
February 1938: the relation ends when the council is 'absorbed into the collaborationist Provisional Government of China in February 1938' (infobox 1935-1938).

ledger.cpn: Provisional Government of the Republic of China

wars.name: Second Sino-Japanese War
wars.outcome: The Tanggu Truce proved 'only a temporary respite until hostilities erupted again in 1937'; East Hebei was absorbed into the Provisional Government in February 1938, after the war began.

certainty.note: A buffer zone with no surveyed line on any page opened; the 100 km depth is the Tanggu Truce's own figure.

sources.title: Provisional Government of the Republic of China (1937-1940)
